latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the Bonus Stacking System — a structured approach to increasing offer value without discounting.

- Guides users to build irresistible bonus stacks using an 11-point bonus quality checklist.
- Includes a before/after-objection deployment sequence for one-on-one sales conversations.
- Provides a 3-step system for sourcing zero-cost, high-value partner bonuses from adjacent businesses.
- Produces a bonus stack document with named bonuses, assigned values, and optimal presentation order.
- Designed for entrepreneurs looking to strengthen premium offers, dissolve objections, and improve conversion rates.
